work.intro: I started my professional career as a Frontend Developer recently. I have worked on projects and collaborated with awesome teams and people that have helped me grow as a developer and as a person. Here's a summary of my work so far.

dokan.name: Dokan
dokan.summary: Dokan, founded in 2019, wanted to build a new version of their Dokan Tip platform, I joined a team of engineers and designers working across web to build the new platform Creators! (~100k MU) with Next.js.
achievements: Shipped and optimized features for high-traffic (+100,000 users) applications with multi-language support.
Refactored UI components to resolve bugs, improving user experience and interface reliability and integrated REST APIs endpoints and optimized data fetching.
Collaborated with product managers, designers, and developers across multiple teams and different countries.

athr.name: ATHR
athr.summary: I joined ATHR as a UI Developer. I was responsible for designing, building and maintaining the user interface of the web application.
achievements: Designed and built responsive, user-friendly interfaces.
Developed reusable components using React, TypeScript, and Next.js.
Optimized website performance by reducing load times and page weight.
Collaborated with back-end developers to integrate front-end and back-end functionality.
athr.closing: During my time at ATHR, I gained my first production experience using React, learned how to work in a team and how to communicate effectively with other team members.
